final_message: Parsed the log file by reading each entry and its extra lines, filtering only ERROR and CRITICAL levels (case insensitive). Converted timestamps to UTC ISO format. Extracted the message after the service name on the first line. Extracted the last line of any traceback as the exception or null if none. Counted repeats from the following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. Aggregated counts by service summing repeat counts. Wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.
